title: Wow
text: Loved this tour! Stunning views of Barcelona from Montjuïc, beautiful gardens, and a delicious glass of Catalan wine to finish. Our guide was friendly and gave great photo tips.
author: 174nataliiap

title: very good
text:
Guided tour on Montjuïc really great! 🌟  
The guide was prepared, nice and explained the history and places in a very interesting way. The view over Barcelona is beautiful and the tour was organized very well. Highly recommended to those who want to discover this wonderful place!
Super appreciated also the advice on the place where to eat paella and fideua, all exceptional
author: giuliadY7025KK

title: Great tour!
text: I really enjoyed the Montjuïc tour. The views were beautiful, and it was nice to explore places I probably wouldn’t have found on my own. The guide was friendly and shared interesting information, but it still felt relaxed and easy. I’m glad I went and would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona.
author: Sightsee34399599934

title: Best experience with the best panorama!
text: As a solo traveler, this tour was ideal. Intimate small group where I could easily chat with others and the guide without feeling lost in a crowd. The walk through Montjuïc’s magical paths and viewpoints offered breathtaking city panoramas that felt personal and unhurried. The wine tasting overlooking Barcelona was a dreamy solo highlight!
author: tribetronics

title: Beautiful views and  good wine
text: Stunning views over Barcelona and a super relaxed atmosphere. The glass of wine made the experience feel extra special. The guide was fun and kind, and gave me great tips on where to eat.❤️
author: faraonefoto

title: Delicious wine and amazing views!
text:
The Montjuïc tour was fantastic!! Beautiful photo spots and views of the city. 
The wine was delicious and great value for the price, which made the experience even better. Totally recommended!
author: nanna b

title: The best views and photos...
text: The best views and photos of Barcelona! The walk was very comfortable and the guide Francesca really kind. Highly recommended!
author: Mirto_K

title: The best views of Barcelona with good wine! :)
text: I love it! The views, the wine and the people, the guide was very knowledgeable, friendly and gave us great advices!!
